feed.title: Apple Takes Aim at AI Agents, Wants Mac Users to Know When Their Data Is Accessed as Meta Tackles Muse Privacy Claims
feed.summary: Apple plans to update macOS to notify users when AI agents, like Meta's Muse, try to access system data, addressing privacy concerns. This move comes after criticism that AI agents, which can bypass standard protections with "Full Disk Access," might expose sensitive personal information. Apple emphasized its commitment to user privacy and will implement new security controls requiring explicit user action for such data access.

feed.title: AAPL To Flag AI Requests For Data Access On Macs Amid Complaints Over META's Muse Agent
feed.summary: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is enhancing privacy controls on Mac computers by requiring more explicit user action for applications to gain broad access to data via its Full Disk Access feature, citing risks from increasingly autonomous AI agents. This move follows criticisms regarding Meta Platforms Inc.'s (META) Muse AI agent and its alleged access to private Messages content, though Meta disputes these claims. Apple emphasizes the need for users to make informed decisions about data access in the era of advanced AI.

feed.title: South Korea and U.S. Ink Massive Nuclear Energy Plan
feed.summary: South Korea and the U.S. have announced a major agreement to build eight large-scale nuclear reactors (two APR1400s and six AP1000s) in the U.S. by 2030, with a planned investment of $120 billion. However, an analysis raises concerns about the feasibility of the aggressive timeline, lack of commitments from U.S. utilities, and challenges in securing congressional funding due to rapidly escalating national debt. The article also covers other nuclear energy developments, including a Constellation-Amazon power purchase agreement, Holtec's SMR-300 PSAR submission, General Matter's license application for a Paducah enrichment plant, Deployable Energy's selection to test its nuclear battery at NRIC's DOME, NANO Nuclear Energy's acquisition of NRC-licensed fuel processing assets, and a proposed U.S. Fusion Energy Act with a $10 billion investment.
